chapters.name: Irregular regions
intro: Blocks can be any shape now.
A slide still stops on the first square of a new block.

chapters.name: Walls
intro: Walls stop a slide one square short.
Use them to stop where you need to.

chapters.name: Traps
intro: Traps send you back to the start.
Slide into one and the move still counts.

chapters.name: Teleporters
intro: Slide into one and you come out of the other, still sliding.
